blockers: The current MuJoCo environment exposes env_nq=1 and therefore cannot natively represent the 4D arm-joint state semantics seen in control telemetry.

Drawer interaction currently depends on distance, gripper close/open, and translation along the drawer axis, but not on orientation agreement; this makes rotation mismatch real but not causally sufficient to explain the rollout ceiling.
Canonical visual semantics remain far from control (large entropy, edge-density, and std_rgb gaps).
The 100-frame ceiling is a downstream symptom of the current contract. Increasing frame count before repairing embodiment/state-action/visual semantics is not a scientifically valid next step.

summary.statement: CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE of V58 0%: V58 rendered images are near-white (mean=[0.977,0.977,0.977], std=[0.0028,0.0028,0.0028]). LIBERO images have realistic colors (mean=[0.414,0.371,0.329], std=[0.252,0.247,0.241]). Root cause: empty MTL files — drawerbox geom_*.mtl have no material definitions (only Blender header comments, no Kd/Ka/Ks). PyBullet ER_TINY_RENDERER renders objects without materials as white. CRITICAL CONTEXT: Old dataset (3,305 frames) had CONTINUOUS gripper_joint (std=0.0196, range=[-0.042, +0.001]) — frozen gripper was NOT present. V58 trained on this dataset and STILL got 0%. This proves near-white images (NOT frozen gripper) is the real root cause. Fix: add material definitions to URDF or MTL files, then regenerate images.
summary.display_role_reason: active supporting context but not directly driving the current phase

VERIFIED FIXED: P0a completed. dataset_builder._build_libero_state() fix confirmed effective. file-000.parquet verification: gripper_joint std=0.0198, 6,693 unique values, range=[-0.042, +0.001]. Vs OLD LeRobot parquet: std=0.0000, 1 unique value (all = -0.042). NPZ raw data already had healthy continuous values (std=0.0096-0.0834). Root cause was dataset_builder calling _infinigen_to_libero_gripper() on already-continuous values (all < 0.5 → CLOSED=-0.042). Fix: remove incorrect conversion + add LIBERO range clamp.

CANCELLED: P0a gripper_joint fix was correct code engineering but addressed a NON-EXISTENT problem. Live evidence confirms: NPZ raw gripper_joint std=0.0208 (continuous, 40 unique values). stats.json gripper_joint std=0.0196 (continuous, range=[-0.042,+0.001]). V58 dataset had CONTINUOUS gripper_joint throughout — gripper was NEVER frozen. The dataset_builder._build_libero_state() code fix (removed erroneous _infinigen_to_libero_gripper call) was correct engineering but did NOT change the V58 dataset because V58 training happened BEFORE the code fix was committed. V58 0% is NOT caused by frozen gripper.

The earlier strong diagnosis that MINT behaves as an image-only VQ-VAE prior because language-model weights failed to load is contradicted by E033/E034. The key-remap bug is fixed, LM weights load after remapping, and real-LIBERO forward-pass recheck shows mixed nonzero state sensitivity rather than universal state invariance.
